text: {"label":"Single-Case Design Methodology and Meta-Analysis","definition":"Methods for designing, analyzing, appraising, and synthesizing single-case experimental research, including effect size measures, multilevel modeling, autocorrelation, replication and consistency assessment, research practices, and systematic reviews.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on general research design and quantitative synthesis of single-case data, not on functional or synthesized contingency analyses, interobserver agreement, or treatment fidelity and acceptability."}
